---
title: "Lecture library"
subtitle: "Every lecture of ES 661 Probabilistic machine learning, August to November 2023, with its slides, notebooks, cheat sheet and recording."
---

Each row is one lecture, grouped by part of the course. The course is built on one equation, Bayes' rule for the
parameters of a model, and moves from point estimates (maximum likelihood, MAP) to whole posteriors, then to three ways
of approximating a posterior: Laplace, sampling and variational inference. Slides and notebooks are from
[pml-teaching](https://github.com/nipunbatra/pml-teaching); some notebooks are also on the [notebooks page](notebooks/index.qmd).
Every lecture recording is in the [YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UCYaVS9_jGU&list=PLftoLyLEwECBEJyfRBJoSBd0UaTjEcs3I).
Three-minute summary videos, each on one idea, are being added and will appear on the rows they belong to.

[**Slides**: lecture slides (PDF) · **Notebooks**: worked code · **Cheat sheet**: a two-page A4 summary (PDF) ·
**3-min summary**: a three-minute video on one idea; where a row has several, point at a number to see its title ·
**Recording**: the full lecture on YouTube · **Reading**: articles and tutorials for going further.]{.res-key}

::: {.lecture-library}
